description: Indoor SSGI angular-estimator follow-up; independent variants, original defaults and references preserved
notes: All GI intensity values remain the scene default pi²/2. Overrides are independent, not cumulative.
milliseconds includes shader compilation and readback; some runs overlapped. Do not treat as GPU frame-time benchmarks.
Receiver values decode 8-bit sRGB into linear luminance in a 16x16 patch. No tone mapping in these scenes.
Analytic corner is a Lambert point value; GPU measurements average a finite patch; path-tracer reference uses Disney diffuse.
Changed camera views deliberately omit image-reference comparisons.
Added-light increments subtract saved per-renderer direct baselines, which are unaffected by these GI experiments.
